<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="סיון_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518918918_theRebbe_323" batchId="meluket-_D7_A1_D7_99_D7_95_D7_9F_meluket__BH_POST_1766518918918_theRebbe_323__p004">
  <section v="9">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>All the above matters are drawn down through man's service, specifically through the increase in service beyond intellect, which draws from the encompassing level above the chain of descent.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">8)</t>
    <t s="1">And behold, all the matters above,</t>
    <t s="2">their drawing down is through the service of man.</t>
    <t s="3">And this is "And now, please, let the strength of the Lord be increased, as You spoke, saying,"</t>
    <t s="4">for "as You spoke" refers to the speech of the Holy One, blessed be He, to Moshe: "Be for me a help,"</t>
    <t s="5">that Moshe would say, "May your work succeed,"</t>
    <t s="6">that the increase of the strength of the Lord is effected through the service of man</t>
    <t s="7">(the speech of Moshe).</t>
    <t s="8">And according to the known principle</t>
    <t s="9">that the service of man</t>
    <t s="10">(an arousal from below)</t>
    <t s="11">through which the drawing down is effected</t>
    <t s="12">(an arousal from above)</t>
    <t s="13">must be of the same kind as the drawing down,</t>
    <t s="14">it is understood,</t>
    <t s="15">that in order for there to be an increase of the strength of the Lord</t>
    <t s="16">(the fill)</t>
    <t s="17">through drawing into it from the aspect of the Encompassing that is above the chain of descent,</t>
    <t s="18">it is through the increase</t>
    <t s="19">(addition)</t>
    <t s="20">in the service that is according to reason and understanding, by means of drawing and revealing the service that is above reason and understanding.</t>
    <t s="21">And as explained in Tanya</t>
    <t s="22">that the fulfillment of Torah and its mitzvos depends on this, that one always remember the matter of self-sacrifice for G-d, for through remembering the matter of self-sacrifice,</t>
    <t s="23">which is above the chain of descent within man,</t>
    <t s="24">there is an increase and addition in the fulfillment of Torah and mitzvos,</t>
    <t s="25">which is the chain of descent within man.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="10">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>To draw the Encompassing and increase the strength of the Lord, one must connect service above reason with the aspect of the primordial intellect, as explained through the two interpretations of "with all his strength" regarding answering "Amen, may His great Name be blessed."</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">And in more particular terms, it can be said,</t>
    <t s="1">that in order for there to be a drawing down of the Encompassing and an increase in the strength of the Lord,</t>
    <t s="2">one must connect the service that is above reason and understanding with the aspect of the primordial intellect.</t>
    <t s="3">And this is what our Rabbis, of blessed memory, said:</t>
    <t s="4">"Whoever answers 'Amen, may His great Name be blessed' with all his strength, they tear up his decree of seventy years,"</t>
    <t s="5">for "with all his strength" has two interpretations.</t>
    <t s="6">Rashi's explanation:</t>
    <t s="7">"With all his strength" means with all the strength of his intention,</t>
    <t s="8">and the explanation of Tosafos:</t>
    <t s="9">with a loud voice.</t>
    <t s="10">And one can explain this,</t>
    <t s="11">that through saying "Amen, may His great Name be blessed" with all his strength, there is an increase of the strength of the Lord.</t>
    <t s="12">For "His great Name" is His great Name,</t>
    <t s="13">the Encompassing that is above the chain of descent,</t>
    <t s="14">for through the drawing down of the Encompassing, there is an increase of the strength of the Lord, as above.</t>
    <t s="15">Therefore, through saying "Amen, may His great Name be blessed," they tear up his decree of seventy years,</t>
    <t s="16">for the decree is due to the blemish in the Name of the Lord,</t>
    <t s="17">and through the increase of the strength of the Lord, the blemish is rectified.</t>
    <t s="18">And in order for there to be a drawing down of "His great Name" into the aspect of the strength of the Lord,</t>
    <t s="19">it is through the two matters</t>
    <t s="20">(the interpretations)</t>
    <t s="21">of "with all his strength."</t>
    <t s="22">For "all his intention" is the intention of the desire of the heart that is above reason and understanding,</t>
    <t s="23">above the chain of descent within man,</t>
    <t s="24">and "a loud voice" is the speech that arouses the aspect of the primordial intellect,</t>
    <t s="25">the root of the chain of descent.</t>
    <t s="26">And through the fact that all his intention is not only in thought but comes in a loud voice,</t>
    <t s="27">through this the drawing down of "His great Name" into the strength of the Lord is effected.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="11">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>The power to draw from above the chain of descent through man's service was granted at the Giving of the Torah, as indicated by the phrase "as You spoke, saying," which connects to the speech of the Holy One and the power given to Moshe and all Israel.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">9)</t>
    <t s="1">And behold, it is known</t>
    <t s="2">that the service of man reaches until the root of the creations,</t>
    <t s="3">the aspect of the chain of descent,</t>
    <t s="4">and that which through service is also drawn from above the chain of descent,</t>
    <t s="5">this is through a power given from above that was drawn down at the Giving of the Torah.</t>
    <t s="6">And this is "as You spoke, saying,"</t>
    <t s="7">that this, that through the service of man</t>
    <t s="8">("saying")</t>
    <t s="9">there is an increase of the strength of the Lord,</t>
    <t s="10">that the increase is through drawing down the Encompassing that is above the chain of descent,</t>
    <t s="11">this is "as You spoke,"</t>
    <t s="12">for "as You spoke" refers</t>
    <t s="13">(also)</t>
    <t s="14">to "saying"</t>
    <t s="15">(as above at the beginning of the maamar),</t>
    <t s="16">that through the speech of the Holy One, blessed be He, "Be for me a help,"</t>
    <t s="17">the power was given</t>
    <t s="18">(to Moshe,</t>
    <t s="19">and through him to every single Jew)</t>
    <t s="20">that through his service he can effect an increase of the strength of the Lord.</t>
    <t s="21">And according to what was brought above, that this power</t>
    <t s="22">(that through service, the light that is above the chain of descent will also be drawn down)</t>
    <t s="23">was drawn down at the Giving of the Torah,</t>
    <t s="24">it can be said,</t>
    <t s="25">that "as You spoke, saying" refers</t>
    <t s="26">(also)</t>
    <t s="27">to "And G-d spoke, saying"</t>
    <t s="28">that was said at the Giving of the Torah,</t>
    <t s="29">that also the explanation of "And G-d spoke, saying" is that G-d spoke so that Israel would say all these words</t>
    <t s="30">(which refers also to the entire Torah as a whole)</t>
    <t s="31">in the manner of "saying,"</t>
    <t s="32">to say the things that the Holy One, blessed be He, says.</t>
    <t s="33">That is, through the fact that man says words of Torah,</t>
    <t s="34">he causes that the Holy One, blessed be He, will say these words,</t>
    <t s="35">the drawing down of the Ein Sof light</t>
    <t s="36">(which is above the chain of descent)</t>
    <t s="37">into the Torah</t>
    <t s="38">(the chain of descent).</t>
    <t s="39">And through this, the power is drawn also into the entirety of man's service,</t>
    <t s="40">that through his service</t>
    <t s="41">(in a manner that the aspect above the chain of descent within man illuminates within the chain of descent within him)</t>
    <t s="42">he draws down the light that is above the chain of descent into the chain of descent,</t>
    <t s="43">the drawing down of the Encompassing into the fill.</t>
    <t s="44">And through this, the drawing down of the Encompassing is effected also below, in the world</t>
    <t s="45">(that the drawing down of the Encompassing in the world is also within its inwardness),</t>
    <t s="46">and through this, the intention of the dwelling place</t>
    <t s="47">for Him, blessed be He, in the lower realms is completed.</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
